blocks.text: After you create a privileged portal, you can create and edit privileged consoles on the Privileged Consoles page. After a privileged console is created, you can enable it to appear in the end user's Privileged Remote Access (PRA) Portal. You can enable the same privileged console to appear in one or more privileged portals.
Privileged consoles provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Create privileged consoles that allow end users to access the systems they want to connect to.
Manage which privileged portals the privileged consoles are assigned to.
Update the description for privileged consoles that are displayed to end users.

blocks.text: To learn more about Privileged Remote Access (PRA), see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
On the Privileged Consoles page (Zero Trust Browser > Privileged Remote Access > Privileged Consoles), you can:

blocks.item: View a list of applied filters available from the current and previous user sessions. Applied filters must be saved to the user session first before they can be viewed. Use the drop-down menu to select the applied filters to view. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Hide the filters on the page by clicking Hide Filters. Click Show Filters to display the filters.

Filter the list of privileged consoles linked to a specific privileged portal. By default, all privileged consoles are displayed. You can also save applied filters to your preferences so that they're visible in future user sessions. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Expand all rows in the table to see more information about each privileged console.
View a list of all the privileged consoles that are configured for your organization. For each console, you can see:
Name: The name of the privileged console. Expand the name to view the description, if available.
Display on Console: Indicates if the privileged console is displayed in the user's PRA Portal.
Protocol: The type of protocol the privileged console is using (VNC, RealVNC, SSH, or RDP).
Domain: The domain used for the console.
Port: The port number used for the console.

blocks.text: If you delete a privileged console, you can no longer form a new connection and the privileged console is removed from the end user's PRA Portal. If there are any existing connections prior to the deletion of the privileged console, these connections remain accessible until the browser is closed.

blocks.item: Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
